title: A Postcard for the Songbook
author: Ivo Nakamura
blurb: Rafael Halloran, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
